title: Do not decorate the life that forgot the Beloved
summary: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside. Do not decorate what duality is crumbling.
takeaway: Do not decorate what duality is crumbling.
lifeApplication: Before another surface fix, ask where love of duality is already turning the wall to sand.

source.shortMeaning: A life deceived by duality cannot be beautified from the outside.
source.lifeApplication: When you reach for another surface fix, ask what the Shabad still needs to heal.
